name: D no Kajitsu Hime-sama ga Arawareta!
original_name: Dの果実 姫さまがあらわれた！
source:
Female witch and male knight separate from the search party. They won't come back this night as they use this sweet time just for the two of them.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-november-2005-sharin-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
